import os
os.makedirs(p.parent, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height divider lines partition the grid into tiles.
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in div_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in div_cols}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in divider_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_cuts = [-1] + div_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + div_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts)-1)]
    col_spans = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts)-1)]
    tiles = [(rs, cs) for rs in row_spans for cs in col_spans]
    source = None
    for rs, cs in tiles:
        if any(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(*rs) for c in range(*cs)):
            source = (rs, cs)
            break
    if source is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    srs, scs = source
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(*scs)] for r in range(*srs)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs, cs in tiles:
        for i, r in enumerate(range(*rs)):
            for j, c in enumerate(range(*cs)):
                out[r][c] = pattern[i % len(pattern)][j % len(pattern[0])]
    return out
'''
